children: Cohen Circle Acquisition Corp. II reported lower net income in the third quarter as interest earned on trust-account securities declined, while general and administrative costs increased. The blank-check company said it has not begun operations and expects no operating revenue until after a business combination.
: Marketable securities held in the Trust Account totaled $264.6M at September 30, 2026.
: The company is identifying a target and intends to complete a business combination by July 2, 2027.
: The company reported $841,878 in cash outside the Trust Account and a $791,109 working capital surplus at September 30, 2026.

: Management said substantial doubt exists about the company’s ability to continue as a going concern, citing liquidity needs and mandatory liquidation if no business combination is completed by the deadline.
